title: UniSuper sharpens investment oversight with daily data
full_text:
UniSuper has moved to a daily, consolidated view of its investment exposures after completing a data integration program spanning its entire fund structure.
The fund has become the first client to adopt additional capabilities within BNP Paribas’ Data PRISM360 platform, which is powered by financial software provider NeoXam.
Covering every holding across UniSuper, the datasets add classification, reference and market attributes before being transferred into the fund’s own data environment on a daily cycle.
The change gives UniSuper’s investment team a consistent view of its holdings, allowing exposures to be aggregated and analysed across different parts of the portfolio and investment hierarchy.
UniSuper head of portfolio implementation and liquidity management Dharmendra Dayabhai said the implementation would support the fund’s broader shift towards data-led investment decisions.
“This marks an important milestone for UniSuper. We now receive daily datasets that are purpose-built to support our investments operating model, with a clear focus on reliable, high-quality data.
“The model we have adopted leans on the technological expertise of NeoXam, with the industrialisation of that platform and its day-to-day support provided by BNP Paribas’ Securities Services business. We have now laid a strong foundation for our journey towards better data-led decision making.”
UniSuper currently manages more than $175 billion for over 688,000 members, placing the fund among Australia’s largest profit-to-member superannuation funds.
The latest implementation builds on the December 2024 launch of Data PRISM360 by BNP Paribas and NeoXam, followed by the delivery of monthly environmental, social and governance datasets.
NeoXam chief executive Florent Fabre said the expanded system allowed exposures to be examined across complex investment structures and multiple dimensions.
“The go-live of these new capabilities shows what Data PRISM360 was built for and what we aspire to do for our clients.
“Together with BNP Paribas’ Securities Services teams in Melbourne, Sydney and globally, we have delivered UniSuper an investment exposure book of record with an ESG overlay, where they can look through complex structures and aggregate exposures across multiple dimensions, at any point in the fund’s investment hierarchy.
“Our role is to help clients turn data into investment decisions today, and to keep building as their needs evolve.”
BNP Paribas head of investment analytics and data services Rémi Toucheboeuf said the rollout represented a further expansion of the custodian’s relationship with UniSuper.
“The successful implementation of the investment exposure solution represents another significant step in our partnership with UniSuper. By extending the capabilities of Data PRISM360, UniSuper benefits from a more integrated and scalable investment data platform, enabling greater transparency and stronger data governance.
“We look forward to continuing our support of clients like UniSuper as they advance their strategic objectives.”
